title: Beyond Worst-Case Branching: Quantum Tree Search via Amplitude Amplification
summary: In this work, we investigate quantum tree search via amplitude amplification. Amplitude amplification generalizes Grover's algorithm by replacing the Hadamard initialization with an arbitrary unitary $A$, with Grover's algorithm recovered as the special case of uniform initialization. We demonstrate the construction of a dynamic search tree of depth $m$ with query complexity $\sqrt{\left(b_{avg}\right)^m}$ where $b_{avg}$ denotes the average branching factor, improving upon the commonly assumed $\sqrt{\left(b_{max}\right)^m}$, where $b_{max}$ is the maximum branching factor.
